title: Curve metapools count their base-pool LP leg
summary: A Curve metapool's retained TVL is now its full pool value, base-pool LP leg (3Crv, crv2pool, FRAXBP and similar) included, as Curve and DeFiLlama report it. Pharos had read Curve's usdTotalExcludingBasePool, which drops that leg entirely: LUSD/3Crv published $4.3M of a $12.9M pool. No tracked coin is credited with a metapool's base-LP leg, so the exclusion prevented no double count; it removed the depth the metapool coin trades against.
impact: On 2026-11-14 Curve data, 15 metapools pairing 14 tracked coins gain about $12.7M of retained TVL: LUSD +$8.65M ($4.26M to $12.91M), USD1 +$2.12M, Mezo mUSD +$0.81M and GUSD +$0.72M (about 3x); STBT, eUSD, msUSD, FRAX, alUSD, TUSD, NXUSD, OUSD, MAI and DOLA gain less than $0.15M each.

Global headline TVL rises by the same amount, about 0.14%. A base-LP leg is a claim on its base pool, whose own TVL is also in the global headline; that overlap is accepted as the cost of measuring each metapool's real depth.

Metapool balance is measured on the same full-pool basis as its TVL, so the v6.94 scope-matching rule has nothing left to withhold: LUSD/3Crv now carries its measured one-third LUSD, two-thirds 3Crv split (ratio about 0.49) instead of the neutral unmeasured fallback. Balance health, Pool Quality and pool stress move with it; incomplete balance captures still stay unmeasured.

Reviewed composite metapool targets size measured-execution probes from the same retained TVL: MUSD/crv2pool crosses the $2.5M tier and NXUSD/av3CRV the $250K tier. Probe notionals and admission rules are unchanged. Metapool DEX price observations are weighted by, and held to the unchanged $50K floor on, the same full TVL, so eUSD/FRAXBP can now contribute one. The display-only permanent-liquidity figure follows the published TVL, so LUSD/3Crv's 89% locked share reads about $11.5M instead of $3.85M.

Retained TVL is measured differently for these pools, so the TVL-basis break list appends 7.1; trend consumers compare stored measurement epochs rather than reading the step as a market move. Component weights are unchanged.

title: Independent native prices for reviewed retained markets
summary: Reviewed native venue observations can price retained USDA and pathUSD markets through the existing direct_api family. The quote token must have an independently admitted current USD price; neither source labels nor a second read of the same physical market create a second contribution.
impact: USDA reuses the current run's factory-verified, block-pinned PancakeSwap V2 USDA/USDT reserves. Its USD price is the reserve ratio times the trusted USDT mark, with support capped by retained TVL and independently valued reserves. No additional RPC reads or target-price feedback are introduced.

pathUSD reads Tempo's native exchange at a fresh pinned block, verifies the OUSD/pathUSD and USDT/OUSD route identities, and requires two-sided native quotes supporting at least the existing $50K price-observation floor. Support is only the demonstrated USD notional capped by retained TVL; singleton custody, headline book inventory and intermediate OUSD prices never value the route.

Both observations retain the older venue/quote-parent clock and replace only price provenance and bounded price support after the CoinGecko refresh. Existing pool identity deduplication, freshness, $1M/two-family depeg admission and closure rules remain unchanged. Liquidity weights, retained TVL and volume are unchanged; this is no retained-TVL measurement-epoch break.

USDR remains unadmitted: the observed RISE Icarus inventory has only one pool above the unchanged $50K floor, and its concrete USDC.e deployment has no independently admitted USD valuation. Its blind-event review remains scoped and dated.
